scope: Read-only code/ownership/lifecycle review with tiny existing native-owner/state-machine checks. No app source, renderer, actual KTX2 decode, browser, native memory meter or whole gate run.

concrete_initial_blocker_and_minimal_fix.blocker: Full registerKTX2 originally retained raw-loader delivery. GLTF/shared-image clones shallow-copy mip level descriptors, so newly enabled desktop release could empty a raw cached Full decode. Initial Full-loader identity test and separate residency fixture did not combine these operations.
concrete_initial_blocker_and_minimal_fix.minimal_fix: Profile-independent GLB delivery adapter clones each delivered mip descriptor. Full preserves original Source identity, dimensions and every byte; Light additionally selects stable reduced Source. Raw and reduced cached variants stay populated after a delivery release.
concrete_initial_blocker_and_minimal_fix.regression_controls: Ten combined controls use real pinned GLTF binary parser, two distinct samplers, actual production adapter/residency logic, release, second cached GLTF read and near/far/revisit for both Full and Light.

supported_findings: Per-delivery descriptor copies prevent level.data release from mutating another adapter delivery or raw cached mip payloads. Stable Light WeakMap Source preserves shared GPU-source identity while reducing exactly mip0.

Desktop retains encoded recovery inputs whenever residency is enabled; stand-ins are built before source level release; release still waits for all texture/sampler owners to have current GPU versions, and refuses release without encoded recovery.
Actual parser controls preserve different sampler settings and selected payloads; failed refill preserves populated stand-in and reports the actual decoding error.

Encoded recovery stores the delivery adapter, not a parser/raw Texture. Existing loader task cache is weak-keyed by input buffers; adapter forgets settled worker resolvers. Actual GC savings remain a measurement question.
Desktop ImageBitmap closing remains disabled. Full geometry/shaders/source GLBs/mip bytes and all memory/detail ceilings are unchanged.

context_scope.actual_existing_policy: First restored loss may reload once; later losses offer tier reduction/manual Reload.
context_scope.current_native_context_control: Existing crash-guard event state machine passed; this is not a real GPU/browser context test.
context_scope.required_next: Actual desktop WEBGL_lose_context loss/restoration/reloaded usable frame with real released compressed sources; existing phone smoke does not substitute.

remaining_acceptance_requirements: Actual same-source before/after /1904 memory at both desktop and mobile widths under unchanged 1125/400MiB ceilings; preserve original failures and exact source/build/profile bindings.
Actual KTX2 decoder/native GL errors/source integrity, near/far/return retranscode/reupload and exact mip-chain/layout checks.
Actual Light appearance comparison for the existing mip policy and desktop unchanged-image lifecycle, including usable context-restored/reloaded frame.
Required full source preflight and normal checked-head delivery after native evidence supports adoption; no cap raises or ticket/APP/DEV/photo acceptance inferred here.
